stations.title: Bridie
stations.say: Full? Then how many seats are left?

stations.title: Your exceptions
stations.gap: No word for a full boat

stations.title: Passenger
stations.say: Two left? We will take them.

captions: The booking desk. Bridie wants a full boat to say how many seats are left.
Today a full boat only says no, and a smudged line says nothing about why.
You write exceptions of the hut's own, with what the caller needs, causes kept.
Now a full boat offers the seats it has left, and a bad line says what was wrong.
Exceptions with the hut's own names. Part 5 is done: when it goes wrong.
